title: Nepal’s Gen Z Is Taking on the World’s Polluters Over Climate Disasters
summary_full: The young government of Nepal, a nation with a tiny carbon footprint, is seeking reparations from the world’s major economies as it bears the brunt of collapsing Himalayan glaciers.
